title: Slit Geometry (Bach et al. 2013)
html:
Remark. Slit Geometry (Bach et al. 2013)

The double-slit geometry used throughout the experiment:

Parameter Value
Slit width a 50 nm
Slit separation d (center-to-center) 280 nm
Slit height 4 \mum
Support structure 150 nm, midway along height
Electron energy E 600 eV
de Broglie wavelength \lambda 50 pm
Mask width 5 \mum
Mask height 10 \mum
Mask--slit distance 230 \mum
Total system length \sim 1 m

The mask was held in a frame controlled by a piezoelectric actuator, allowing continuous positioning to block one slit, both slits, or neither slit in a non-destructive, reversible manner.
